meta.title: O*NET-SOC Careers Library
meta.description: A browsable directory of non-tech occupations organized by the O*NET-SOC 2019 taxonomy. Every code links to its official O*NET OnLine summary page with detailed tasks, skills, wages, and outlook.
meta.license: O*NET data is in the public domain (CC BY 4.0). Codes and titles follow O*NET-SOC 2019.
